records.title: Can a Language Model Learn Facts Continually in Its Weights?
records.supported_claim: Sequential invented-fact writes showed 1% bare-statement retention versus 46% with diverse restatements after 20 later writes; intrusion and prompt-recovery diagnostics distinguish access from erasure.
records.caveat: Single-author/single-family preprint; invented facts and tested Qwen3 procedures; no general base-rate claim.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: RL Forgets! Towards Continual Policy Optimization
records.supported_claim: CPO reports 13.7% less forgetting and 7.0% improved prior capability in the tested Qwen3-VL-8B MRCL setting.
records.caveat: Fresh preprint; one model/task protocol; not evidence for all RL post-training.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: Beyond Perplexity: A Behavioral Evaluation Framework for Deployment-Memory Claims in LLM Test-Time Training
records.supported_claim: Lower training loss can coexist with exactly zero free-form recall in controlled nonce-fact test-time training.
records.caveat: Controlled synthetic diagnostic; not a population estimate for test-time learning.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: Hidden Forgetting in Continual Multimodal Learning: When Accuracy Survives but Grounding Fails
records.supported_claim: Answer accuracy can remain while grounding/evidence use changes during continual multimodal adaptation.
records.caveat: Multimodal benchmark scope; fresh preprint and not direct proof of hidden weight erasure.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: MemSecBench: Tracking Agent Memory Poisoning from Persistence to Consequence and Repair
records.supported_claim: MemSecBench reports a 310-scenario, 24-configuration matrix and 84.2%, 50.3%, and 56.1% headline security outcomes.
records.caveat: Fresh preprint; non-adaptive attacks and the tested harness/backend/model matrix only.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
records.supported_claim: ChronoMem implements semantic global rollback and post-exposure recovery with ADK integration.
records.caveat: "First" is author-asserted; implementation evidence does not prove exhaustive deletion closure.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: MemDelta: Controlled Baselines and Hidden Confounds in Agent Memory Evaluation
records.supported_claim: MemDelta demonstrates rank reversals and confounds across controlled memory comparisons, including the audited numerical bundle.
records.caveat: Single-author preprint; LongMemEval-S, n=500 overall; results are benchmark-specific.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: Is Our Benchmark Enough? An Analysis of Continual Learning for MLLMs
records.supported_claim: Shows separability, fixed-order, and routing pathologies in a multimodal continual-learning benchmark.
records.caveat: ICML 2026 workshop paper, not main-track; critique of one benchmark.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: Can Scale Save Us From Plasticity Loss in Large Language Models?
records.supported_claim: Plasticity loss appears in stationary and continual multilingual GPT-style training, with sublinear onset scaling.
records.caveat: Tested only 5M–314M non-embedding parameters and a narrow probe; frontier extrapolation unverified.; confidence: medium-high

records.title: Revisiting Replay and Gradient Alignment for Continual Pre-Training of Large Language Models
records.supported_claim: Five-language Llama CPT; 100B tokens per language; replay-rate and gradient-alignment scaling.
records.caveat: No replay-buffer-size bound; preprint; confidence: medium-high.

records.title: Full-Parameter Continual Pretraining of Gemma 2: Insights into Fluency and Domain Knowledge
records.supported_claim: Narrow LLM EWC result; English mitigation 7/7 and Lithuanian improvement 5/7.
records.caveat: One language pair and Fisher-estimation protocol; confidence: medium.

records.title: Continual Calibration: Coverage Can Collapse Before Accuracy in Lifelong LLM Fine-Tuning
records.supported_claim: 3.4× coverage/accuracy loss ratio; 18%/89% drift decomposition; calibration replay.
records.caveat: Classification/MCQ-heavy; venue status unverified; confidence: medium-high.

records.title: Learning on the Job: Continual Learning from Deployment Feedback for Frozen-Weights Agents
records.supported_claim: Feedback-distilled external memory; 1.6×/2.6× static-RAG result; cross-model memory transfer.
records.caveat: Single author and domain; four repeated trials; confidence: medium-high.

records.title: Learning, Fast and Slow: Towards LLMs That Adapt Continually
records.supported_claim: Fast textual prompt population plus slow RL; 1.4–3× sample efficiency; up to 70% lower KL drift.
records.caveat: Qwen3-8B; three-stage test; external `gpt-5.2` reflection LM; confidence: medium.

records.title: Hyperagents
records.supported_claim: Editable task/meta-agent programs; transferable `imp@50=0.630`.
records.caveat: Agent search, not parametric CL; sandboxed and human-supervised; confidence: medium.

records.title: Learning without training: The implicit dynamics of in-context learning
records.supported_claim: Contextual forward pass as an implicit minimal low-rank MLP update.
records.caveat: Computational/input-conditioned equivalence, not persistent learning; confidence: medium-high.

records.title: Knowledge Base Poisoning Attacks and Defense for Policy-Aware LLM-RAG Framework
records.supported_claim: One-rule/1.6% poisoning yields 85% context corruption; scoped defense.
records.caveat: One 60-rule IoBT KB, 20 prompts, and one scenario; confidence: medium.

records.title: A Theoretical Perspective: How to Prevent Model Collapse in Self-consuming Training Loops
records.supported_claim: Recursive-stability and constant-real-data-proportion convergence conditions.
records.caveat: Conditional theorem, not a universal replay percentage; confidence: high for theorem, low for LLM-scale transfer.

records.title: The Forgetting-Retention Dilemma: Certified Unlearning Theory in Continual Learning
records.supported_claim: Post-unlearning excess-risk decomposition and CL/unlearning trade-off.
records.caveat: Experiments use CIFAR/MNIST with CNN/ResNet models, not LLMs; confidence: medium.

records.title: Orthogonal Subspace Learning for Language Model Continual Learning
records.supported_claim: Orthogonal low-rank adaptation reduces interference on evaluated finite continual-learning sequences.
records.caveat: Finite academic streams; not an indefinite or frontier-scale guarantee; confidence: medium.

records.title: Efficient Continual Pre-training by Mitigating the Stability Gap
records.supported_claim: Identifies and mitigates the early stability gap during continual pretraining.
records.caveat: Protocol-specific and not a complete lifelong-learning architecture; confidence: medium.

records.title: WikiBigEdit: Understanding the Limits of Lifelong Knowledge Editing in LLMs
records.supported_claim: Large-scale benchmark evidence that tested editors degrade over long knowledge-edit sequences.
records.caveat: Applies to evaluated editors and models, not every future editing method; confidence: medium-high.

records.title: TFGN: Task-Free, Replay-Free Continual Pre-Training Without Catastrophic Forgetting at LLM Scale
records.supported_claim: Reports task-free, replay-free continual-pretraining results including near-zero backward transfer in its tested Llama setting.
records.caveat: Unreplicated first-party report with a bounded staged protocol; confidence: low-medium.

records.title: Latent-LoRA: Compact Latent-Space Adapters with Gradient-Free Routing for Continual Learning
records.supported_claim: Proposes compact latent-space adapters and gradient-free routing for continual learning.
records.caveat: Very recent unreplicated preprint; routing and lifecycle costs need independent evaluation; confidence: low-medium.

records.title: Three scenarios for continual learning
records.supported_claim: Distinguishes task-, domain-, and class-incremental evaluation scenarios and task-identity assumptions.
records.caveat: Pre-LLM image settings; transfer is conceptual; confidence: high for identity/taxonomy.

records.title: Continual Learning Through Synaptic Intelligence
records.supported_claim: Establishes synaptic-intelligence importance regularization as a bounded anti-forgetting family.
records.caveat: Small supervised benchmarks, not LLM evidence; confidence: high for source, low for LLM transfer.

records.title: Experience Replay for Continual Learning
records.supported_claim: Supports replay as a strong historical baseline across evaluated RL/classification settings.
records.caveat: Does not establish LLM-scale storage, privacy, or lifecycle feasibility; confidence: high for source, medium-low for transfer.

records.title: On Tiny Episodic Memories in Continual Learning
records.supported_claim: Demonstrates useful small episodic memories in an evaluated image-classification protocol.
records.caveat: Small-memory claims are protocol-specific and do not imply small LLM replay stores; confidence: high for source, low for transfer.

records.title: Making AI Forget You: Data Deletion in Machine Learning
records.supported_claim: Shows that deletion cost and guarantees depend on model class and system design.
records.caveat: Linear/statistical model setting; no direct LLM deletion guarantee; confidence: high for source, low-medium for transfer.

records.title: A Continual Learning Survey: Defying Forgetting in Classification Tasks
records.supported_claim: Supports historical metric conventions and classification-era taxonomy.
records.caveat: Survey, not primary LLM evidence; confidence: high for identity after Crossref correction, medium for conceptual use.
